run_realtime_client: run the RealtimeClient to start a speech-to-speech conversation with Bedrock Nova Sonic via LiteLLM proxy
connect_realtime_client: connect the RealtimeClient to the LiteLLM proxy realtime WebSocket endpoint with an API key
send_session_update: send a session update with voice, temperature, modalities, and turn detection config to the server
receive_messages: receive and process server messages including text deltas, audio deltas, and session events
capture_audio: capture microphone audio at 16kHz and stream chunks to the server via WebSocket
